```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class Url extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, HasUuids;

    protected $fillable = [
        'original_url',
        'short_code',
        ' clicks',
        'is_active',
    ];

    public function generateShortCode()
    {
        $prefix = Str::random(3);
        $base = 62; // 0-9 and A-Z
        $length = 6;
        $characters = '';
        for ($i = 0; $i < $length; ++$i) {
            $index = rand(0, $base - 1);
            $characters .= chr($index + ord('0'));
        }
        return $prefix . '-' . $characters;
    }

    public function incrementClicks()
    {
        $this->clicks++;
        $this->save();
    }

    public function isShortCodeAvailable()
    {
        $shortCode = Str::lower($this->original_url);
        $existingUrl = Url::where('short_code', '=', $shortCode)->first();
        return !$existingUrl;
    }
}
```
